name: The Gateway
aliases: Performing Arts Center of Suffolk County
description: A nonprofit professional theater in Bellport, also known as the Gateway Playhouse, that stages Broadway-style musicals and holiday shows. It also runs a Halloween haunted house, acting classes and special fundraiser events.

dancing.notes: Shows here are in a traditional theater with numbered seats in rows, so there is no dance floor. Go to watch the show, not to dance.

evidence.note: Official site: 2026 season of stage musicals such as Million Dollar Quartet Christmas, the Haunted Playhouse, classes, and the box office address and phone.
Ticket site seating chart shows assigned seats by row and seat number in the theater.
